title: Launeddas Triple Pipe
tagline: Play the notes. Keep the drone alive.
description: The Sardinian triple reed pipe as a rhythm game: tap the melody on two hand pipes while you squeeze the cheeks to keep the drone breathing. Four original dance tunes, a Think coach, or watch and learn.
howToPlay: Tap the notes on the low and high pipe pads as they reach the line.
The air gauge drains with time and with every note.
Hold the BREATH pad to squeeze the cheeks and refill the air.
While you squeeze the reeds are silent: breathe in the rests.
If the air hits zero for too long, the drone dies and the tune ends.
